reviewer.independence: post-run CPU-only adversarial review; no Modal invocation, no GPU consumption, and no source edits

question: Would I accept this as a valid capacity-reclamation baseline if I did not know the team wanted to build an FPGA?
summary: The paid v4 attempt verified the immutable authorization and exact two-A100 topology, but a fixed 160-second controller readiness deadline terminated both workers before either readiness barrier, probe, sanity guard, rollout-state preparation, or reclamation transaction. The timeout is not evidence that either engine became unhealthy: both logs show normal model load and compilation progress through initial profiling/warmup immediately before SIGTERM. No v10 capacity-reclamation result exists. A further attempt is now unauthorized because the configured ledger has only 501.83279108000715 A100-seconds remaining versus the unchanged evidence-derived requirement of 938 A100-seconds.

hardware_observations.reason: No readiness result, health failure, failed probe, or stable-HBM result was emitted. Both workers reached vLLM compilation and initial profiling/warmup, then the controller killed them at its readiness timeout.

high_severity_findings.finding: No integrated v10 transaction ran. There are no control, overload-trigger, preservation, HBM-reclamation, two-GPU recovery, queue-drain, restore, branch-correctness, serving-interference, or independently computed v10 movement results.
high_severity_findings.required_resolution: Do not freeze or tag a v10 naive baseline, generate success-only plans or plots, or report historical v9 measurements as v10. Report every unmeasured transaction metric as NOT MEASURED and scientifically_valid as false.

high_severity_findings.finding: The controller used initialization_timeout_seconds=160 as a hard readiness wait while the phase-budget row assigns 160 seconds to readiness plus two sanity guards and measures readiness from a different boundary. The workers were still making normal initialization progress, so this is a local deadline/phase-boundary implementation failure, not demonstrated engine unhealthiness or a scientific readiness regression.
high_severity_findings.required_resolution: Classify the attempt failure as a local control-plane readiness timeout. Before any future authorized attempt, align per-phase deadline boundaries with the evidence-derived budget without weakening the global 469-second envelope. Do not cite this timeout itself as a valid scientific blocker.

high_severity_findings.finding: The current experiment-root scientific-validity, manifest, and non-final v10 reports still describe the earlier v3 live-review timeout and fixed 1,800-A100-second reservation; they do not represent v4 and would materially misstate the final outcome if delivered.
high_severity_findings.required_resolution: Supersede the stale v3 objects with hash-bound v4 failure artifacts and the terminal BUDGET_BLOCKER classification. Preserve the older evidence under its own attempt path.

medium_severity_findings.finding: The v4 raw failure validity object correctly fails closed overall, but it sets authorization_alid, phase_budget_valid, budget_pass, and cleanup_pass false even though independent evidence proves those gates passed. This obscures the true failure boundary.
medium_severity_findings.required_resolution: In the canonical post-cleanup v4 validity object, retain true for independently proven pre-GPU authorization, phase-budget, launch-budget, and cleanup gates; retain false for two-engine readiness and every dependent scientific gate. The AND must remain false.

medium_severity_findings.finding: The worker logs prove load/compile progress only. They do not prove both-engine readiness, compilation-free measured execution, probe TTFT, stable HBM, or runtime health.
medium_severity_findings.required_resolution: Limit hardware reporting to the verified two-A100 inventory/topology and explicitly mark readiness, 12-rps sanity, 15-rps sanity, and every transaction metric NOT MEASURED.

medium_severity_findings.finding: Budget settlement, failed-run settlement, canonical validity, cleanup evidence, and this post-run review were generated after the remote manifest and therefore require their own final manifest hashes.
medium_severity_findings.required_resolution: Bind all post-download artifacts in the final experiment manifest so the diagnostic-only result is content-addressed and reproducible.

accepted_diagnostic_claims: The immutable authorization was verified locally and remotely with no live review exchange.
Exactly two A100-SXM4-80GB devices with bidirectional peer access were allocated.
Both vLLM workers made initialization progress but did not reach the strict readiness gate before the controller deadline.
The controller aborted before sanity guards and before every reclamation-dependent phase.
The failed attempt consumed 367.147558954 actual and 675.6962114999988 conservative A100-seconds.
Modal cleanup completed and the reservation was cleared.
The configured remaining authorization is insufficient for another 938-A100-second attempt.
prohibited_claims: real v10 rollout state was prepared
useful reclaimed serving capacity was demonstrated
the queue drained or the serving SLO was restored
8 of 8 branches resumed correctly in v10
a frozen naive v10 baseline exists
the readiness timeout demonstrates an engine readiness regression
